format: 16:9, 8-10 min, one topic in depth, 10 chapters

episodes.title: 10 Space Facts That Sound Fake (But Are 100% Real)
episodes.fact_ideas: Voyager 1 one light-day away; 40,000-year-old sunlight; Sun = 99.8% of mass; Olympus Mons; Uranus on its side; neutron-star teaspoon; Enceladus geysers; Moon footprints; Sgr A*; diamond rain.

episodes.title: Your Body Is Doing 10 Things That Sound Fake
episodes.fact_ideas: Ideas to verify: stomach lining renews in days; you're slightly taller in the morning; bones are ~5x stronger than steel by weight?; your body has ~37 trillion cells; you glow faintly (ultra-weak bioluminescence, Kyoto 2009); babies have ~300 bones; skin sheds; nose can distinguish many odours; heart beats ~100,000 times a day; eyes see a single photon? (verify carefully, drop anything shaky).

episodes.title: 10 Deep-Sea Facts That Sound Fake
episodes.fact_ideas: Ideas: we've mapped Mars better than our seafloor (verify current %); Mariana Trench depth vs Everest; whale fall ecosystems; giant squid eye size; vampire squid; underwater lakes/brine pools; hydrothermal vents life without sunlight; bioluminescence share of deep-sea animals; Greenland shark age 270–500 yrs; ocean produces ~half of Earth's oxygen.

episodes.title: 10 Animal Superpowers That Sound Fake
episodes.fact_ideas: Ideas: mantis shrimp punch; tardigrade survival; axolotl regeneration; pistol shrimp snap; electric eel voltage; peregrine falcon dive speed; octopus arms with neurons; immortal jellyfish (brief); bombardier beetle; homing pigeons / magnetoreception.

episodes.title: 10 Real Moments in History That Sound Fake
episodes.fact_ideas: Ideas: Great Emu War (1932); Anglo-Zanzibar war; dancing plague of 1518; Napoleon/rabbits story (verify!); Cleopatra/Moon landing; Oxford vs Aztecs; mammoths & pyramids; Titanic baker survived cold (verify); the 1904 Olympic marathon; London beer flood 1814.

episodes.title: 10 Facts About Earth That Sound Fake
episodes.fact_ideas: Ideas: Earth isn't a perfect sphere; a day is getting longer; there's a 'Point Nemo'; lightning ~44 times per second worldwide; the Sahara was green ~6,000 years ago; Earth's magnetic poles flip; Antarctica desert; Hawaii moving; gold in the core; tallest mountain from base is Mauna Kea.

episodes.title: Time Is Weirder Than You Think: 10 Facts
episodes.fact_ideas: Ideas: GPS satellites' clocks run fast vs Earth (relativity, ~38 µs/day); leap seconds; dinosaur 23.5h days; Russia has 11 time zones; France has 12 incl. territories; the 'missing' 11 days of 1752 (Britain); Samoa skipped a day in 2011; atomic clocks; a year on Mercury vs its day; the oldest living tree.

episodes.title: 10 Inventions That Happened by Accident
episodes.fact_ideas: Ideas: penicillin; microwave oven (melted chocolate bar); Post-it notes; X-rays; bubble wrap; super glue; pacemaker; Velcro (burrs); potato chips story (verify, often legend); vulcanised rubber.
